title.narrative: Enhancing Capacities for Young Women and Youth-led Enterprises forregional Trade (ECoWYERT-ZWE

description.narrative: The Enhancing Capacities of Young Women and Youth-Led Enterprises for Regional Trade (ECoWYERT) project supports the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area by strengthening regional integration and intra-African trade. Led by the United Nations Development Programme, the project focuses on empowering youth and women—who form the majority of Africa’s population—by building the capacity of youth-led MSMEs in entrepreneurship, innovation, financial literacy, and market readiness. It addresses key barriers to growth through improved access to finance, digital inclusion, and enhanced participation in regional value chains. Implemented in six countries in partnership with key regional institutions over the period 2025–2030, ECoWYERT aims to reduce poverty, create sustainable jobs, and drive inclusive economic transformation across the continent.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
